scope: Additive Dragon Duke Stun Blaster L1-18 shockwave damage, stun, target and recovery audit.
game_version: February 2026 Dragon Duke release; dated secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Stun Blaster — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: Stun Blaster is Common Dragon Duke Equipment, Blacksmith level 9, with L1-18 HP bonus 450-2400 and DPS bonus 40-90 matching pinned data.
sources.limitations: No current shockwave damage, stun duration, target eligibility, geometry or pulse timing is given.

sources.title: Stun Blaster
facts: On activation, a shockwave around Dragon Duke damages and stuns defending troops and buildings.
The page reports several short damage pulses and increased health recovery.
sources.limitations: The community page lacks pulse count, timing and rounding; a separate Dragon Duke page says resource buildings and Walls are excluded, which is not independently confirmed.

sources.title: Dragon Duke
facts: The Duke page reports shockwave damage/stun to buildings and defending troops except resource buildings and Walls.
sources.limitations: The Equipment page uses a broader buildings description. This exclusion remains unconfirmed by a primary or dated game-file rule.

sources.title: Pinned Stun Blaster Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: Pinned damage radius label is 8 tiles; L1-18 ability total damage is 150-400, stun duration 4.5-7.5 seconds and DPS bonus 40-90.
sources.limitations: The raw record does not specify pulse count, division of total damage, hitbox geometry, stun semantics or recovery timing.

derivations.result: Retain pinned damage, stun duration and radius labels as catalogue provenance; dated 2026 table corroborates only HP/DPS bonuses and costs
derivations.method: Compare pinned level series with dated equipment table and separate community behavioral descriptions without inventing pulse timing or target classes.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply all 150-400 total damage once at activation
rejected_inferences.reason: Community source reports several damage pulses, while raw field explicitly says total damage; pulse count and schedule are missing.

rejected_inferences.rule: Stun every building and troop within eight center-distance tiles
rejected_inferences.reason: The two community pages disagree on resource buildings and Walls; geometry and air/ground target classes are not established.

rejected_inferences.rule: Suspend every affected attack for exactly 4.5-7.5 seconds from activation
rejected_inferences.reason: Stun start, queued shot handling, expiry, stacking and target eligibility are unspecified.

rejected_inferences.rule: Grant a fixed health recovery amount at activation
rejected_inferences.reason: The raw Stun Blaster payload has HP and DPS bonuses but no hpRecoveryIncrease level field; community text alone does not provide values or timing.

items: current shockwave total damage, stun duration and radius continuity
pulse count, spacing, damage division, rounding and tick order
target classes, resource/Wall exclusion, air eligibility and hitbox geometry
stun launch, attack interruption, expiration and stacking
claimed HP recovery value and timing, plus Pet and Equipment interactions
Viewer shockwave, snapshot, replay and RL loadout state

conclusion: Stun Blaster L1-18 remains partial and catalogue-only. Dated data corroborates Duke HP/DPS bonuses, while pinned data records shockwave damage, stun duration and radius. No primary source or complete deterministic pulse, target, stun or recovery contract was found. No Equipment Core actor is enabled.
